name: Silo Yard
note: Open bando · silos, chimney, factory hall, conveyor gallery
lede: An abandoned industrial site, wide open. Silos, a chimney you can dive, a factory hall full of holes. Seen through a real camera — shutter, lens, exposure, noise. Fly the named lines in one take.

name: Neon Seoul
note: Hongdae at night · neon signs, LED screens, crowds and traffic
lede: Hongdae after midnight. Club streets, walking streets and alleys under hangul neon and LED screens, crowds and taxis below. Seen through a real night camera. Fly the named lines in one take.
subtitle: 홍대 · 새벽 1시
firstTip: FIRST LINE: THE WALKING STREET · THROUGH THE BRACKETS, OVER THE HEADS

take: Lines are named streets, alleys and gaps. Corner brackets mark the start gate of one you haven't flown; the arrow at the top points to the nearest.
CUT: {cut} to end the take and keep everything. The ring in the middle counts it down; touch a stick to cancel.
Cross a line's start gate and the OSD counts it down, HONGIK-RO · 0:18: reach its end gate before 0:00. Each line adds FLOW; {bankT} s without one banks it.
A crash loses the unbanked chain. The bar under FLOW shows when it banks. Bank it or push on: your call.
RESET restarts the take on the walking street, or where you chose to START AT on the pause menu; hold it to go back to the spawn.
